lines.rookie: The Owl's chalk code said TUESDAY. Bruno Valli, the show's sponsor, said he saw Aldo with a box at midnight. But Aldo was in Hall B. The Owl's box held a page of the loan book. On Tuesday, B.V. took the piece out of the lab for three hours.
lines.junior: The Owl's chalk code spelled TUESDAY. Bruno Valli, the show's sponsor, claimed he had seen Aldo with a box at midnight, but Aldo had been in Hall B. The Owl's box held a page of the loan book: on Tuesday, B.V. had taken the piece out of the lab for three hours.
lines.master: Decoded, the Owl's chalk message read TUESDAY. Bruno Valli, the show's sponsor, insisted he had seen Aldo with a box at midnight, yet Aldo had been in Hall B the whole time. Inside the Owl's box was a page of the loan book, revealing that on Tuesday B.V. had taken the piece out of the lab for three hours.
